CNC-02.equipment_name: CNC-02 automatic milling/turning machine (DMG MORI / Fanuc)
CNC-02.title: CNC-02 operation & maintenance manual (OEM Manual 2024)

checkpoints.title: LOTO lockout & power isolation
checkpoints.instruction: Per the CNC-02 manual, p.112, sec. 4.2.1: press the E-Stop, switch off the main breaker and hang a LOTO warning tag before reaching into the machine enclosure.

checkpoints.title: Open safety guard & inspect insert T07
checkpoints.instruction: Per the CNC-02 manual, p.112, sec. 4.2.2: open the left protective guard of the machining area and use a lamp to inspect insert T07. Look for flank wear or a chipped cutting edge.

checkpoints.title: Remove worn insert & fit new insert to torque spec
checkpoints.instruction: Per the CNC-02 manual, p.112, sec. 4.2.3: loosen the clamp screw with a hex key and remove the worn insert T07. Clean the insert pocket, fit a new WNMG-080408 insert and tighten to the rated 4.2 N·m with a torque wrench.

checkpoints.title: Measure spindle/tool runout with a dial indicator
checkpoints.instruction: Per the CNC-02 manual, p.112, sec. 4.2.4: mount a dial indicator on the machine table and touch the probe to the reference surface of the tool holder/spindle. Rotate the spindle gently by hand through 360 degrees. Spindle runout must be less than or equal to the maximum tolerance of 0.005 mm.

checkpoints.title: Close guard & dry-run test
checkpoints.instruction: Per the CNC-02 manual, p.112, sec. 4.2.5: clear away tools, close the protective guard, release the E-Stop, reset alarms on the CNC screen and run the spindle without load at 1,500 RPM for 60 seconds.

IM-05.equipment_name: IM-05 injection molding machine & ABS drying hopper
IM-05.title: IM-05 injection molding machine & ABS drying system maintenance manual (OEM Manual 2024)
IM-05.manual_title: IM-05 injection molding machine & ABS drying system maintenance manual (OEM Manual 2024)

checkpoints.title: Heater lockout & hopper air isolation
checkpoints.instruction: Per SOP-MOLD-02, p.45, sec. 3.1: switch off the drying heater, close the compressed-air supply valve to the drying hopper and vent all residual pressure through the relief valve.

checkpoints.title: Remove the old oil-clogged dryer filter
checkpoints.instruction: Per SOP-MOLD-02, p.45, sec. 3.2: release the clamp, remove the filter cup, take out the old oil-clogged filter cartridge and clean the filter cup housing.

checkpoints.title: Fit new FLT-ABS-04 moisture-separation filter
checkpoints.instruction: Per SOP-MOLD-02, p.45, sec. 3.3: fit the new FLT-ABS-04 filter cartridge, replace the heat-resistant rubber O-ring and tighten the filter cup.

checkpoints.title: Check dew point of the drying air
checkpoints.instruction: Per SOP-MOLD-02, p.46, sec. 3.4: start the dry-air station and attach the dew point sensor. The dew point must reach below the standard of -30.0 °C before material is loaded.

checkpoints.title: Heat up & re-dry ABS resin for 4 hours
checkpoints.instruction: Per SOP-MOLD-02, p.46, sec. 3.5: set the drying temperature to 85 °C and re-dry the ABS resin for at least 4 hours before opening the feed valve to injection unit cavity 3.
